description: Maharashtra launched India's first AI-powered anganwadi in Waddhamna village, Nagpur, blending VR, smart boards, and gamified learning. This Mission Bal Bharari pilot aims to modernize early education and will expand to 40 more centres.
body_lead: Maharashtra launched India's first AI-powered anganwadi in Waddhamna village, Nagpur, blending VR, smart boards, and gamified learning. This Mission Bal Bharari pilot aims to modernize early education and will expand to 40 more centres. In a pioneering move to bring cutting-edge technology to rural classrooms, Maharashtra has launched India’s first artificial intelligence-powered anganwadi centre.
